speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of progressive weakness, sensory deficits, significant weight loss, and your history of anabolic steroid use and alcohol consumption raises concern for a compressive neuropathy, such as Pancoast tumor or severe brachial plexopathy.
